sentences.cs: Minulý víkend jeli Hana a Jakub na chatu.
sentences.en: Last weekend Hana and Jakub went to the cottage.

sentences.cs: Chata stojí v lese, asi hodinu od Prahy.
sentences.en: The cottage stands in the forest, about an hour from Prague.

sentences.cs: Vyjeli v pátek odpoledne, hned po práci.
sentences.en: They set off on Friday afternoon, right after work.

sentences.cs: Cesta byla dlouhá, protože na silnici bylo hodně aut.
sentences.en: The journey was long, because there were a lot of cars on the road.
When they arrived, it was already dark.

sentences.cs: Jakub zatopil v kamnech a Hana uvařila čaj.
sentences.en: Jakub lit the stove and Hana made tea.
On Saturday morning the sun was shining.

sentences.cs: Šli na dlouhou procházku do lesa.
sentences.en: They went for a long walk in the forest.

sentences.cs: Hana našla houby a dala je do košíku.
sentences.en: Hana found mushrooms and put them in the basket.
In the afternoon they worked in the garden.

sentences.cs: Jakub sekal trávu a Hana sázela květiny.
sentences.en: Jakub mowed the grass and Hana planted flowers.

sentences.cs: Večer grilovali maso a povídali si se sousedy.
sentences.en: In the evening they grilled meat and chatted with the neighbours.
On Sunday it rained all day.

sentences.cs: Seděli uvnitř, četli si a hráli karty.
sentences.en: They sat inside, read and played cards.

sentences.cs: Odpoledne museli uklidit a jet zpátky do města.
sentences.en: In the afternoon they had to tidy up and drive back to the city.
"We'll come again next weekend," said Hana.

sentences.cs: Jakub souhlasil, protože na chatě je vždycky klid.
sentences.en: Jakub agreed, because at the cottage it is always peaceful.
